tutorial.welcome.en: Welcome, young leader. I am Sensei Hoshi. Our clan has found a hidden valley in the mountains. Let's build a village no rival can find.
tutorial.welcome.text: Pozdrav, vodja klana. Sem sensei Hoshi. Naš klan je v gorah našel skrito dolino. Zgradimo vas, ki je noben tekmec ne bo našel.

tutorial.mint.collect.en: Your Coin Mint is striking Coins. When a coin floats over it, tap it, then Collect.
tutorial.mint.collect.text: Tvoja kovnica kuje kovance. Ko nad njo zaplava kovanec, ga tapni, nato pa Poberi.

tutorial.mint.build.en: A clan runs on Coins. Tap Build and place a Coin Mint.
tutorial.mint.build.text: Klan živi od kovancev. Tapni Gradi in postavi kovnico.

tutorial.keep.en: Now strengthen the Clan Keep: tap the castle, then Upgrade.
tutorial.keep.text: Zdaj okrepi Klansko trdnjavo: tapni grad, nato Izboljšaj.

tutorial.finishKeep.wait.en: Upgrades take time. The Keep is ready in {time}: come back then, or tap Finish now to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishKeep.wait.text: Izboljšave terjajo čas. Trdnjava bo nared čez {time}: vrni se takrat ali tapni Dokončaj zdaj in porabi malo žada.

tutorial.finishKeep.done.en: The Keep is ready. Well done!

tutorial.army.tower.en: Rival clans will raid us. Build a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build, then the Defense tab): it shoots any raider in range.
tutorial.army.tower.text: Tekmeci klani nas bodo napadali. Ob trdnjavi zgradi Stolp kunajev (Gradi, nato zavihek Obramba): strelja na vsakega napadalca v dosegu.

tutorial.army.all.en: Build a Training Dojo, a Squad Courtyard and a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build: the Army tab, then the Defense tab).
tutorial.army.all.text: Ob trdnjavi zgradi Vadbeni dojo, Dvorišče odredov in Stolp kunajev (Gradi: zavihek Vojska, nato zavihek Obramba).

tutorial.train.en: Open the Army panel and train some Shinobi: fast blades that strike the nearest building.
tutorial.train.text: Odpri ploščo Vojska in izuri nekaj Shinobijev: hitra rezila, ki napadejo najbližjo stavbo.

tutorial.finishTrain.wait.en: Training takes time too: your warriors are ready in {time}. Wait, or tap Finish training to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishTrain.wait.text: Tudi urjenje terja čas: tvoji bojevniki bodo nared čez {time}. Počakaj ali tapni Dokončaj urjenje in porabi malo žada.

tutorial.raid.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack, look over the target, then Attack! On the battlefield I will show you one thing at a time: send your Shinobi in through a glowing point, then smoke them as they reach a tower: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
tutorial.raid.text: Tvoj prvi vpad. Tapni Napad, oglej si cilj, nato Napad! Na bojišču ti pokažem eno stvar naenkrat: Shinobije pošlji noter skozi svetlečo točko, nato jih ovij v dim, ko pridejo do stolpa: na bojevnike v dimu je mogoče streljati le od blizu.

tutorial.end.en: Well fought. Raids fill your storage fast: upgrade the Clan Keep (or a storage) next. Then upgrade the Training Dojo to unlock Saboteurs: they jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike, and smoke your warriors where the fire is heaviest. Collect, upgrade, raid, and join an Alliance.
tutorial.end.text: Dober boj. Vpadi hitro napolnijo tvoja skladišča: zdaj izboljšaj Klansko trdnjavo (ali skladišče). Nato izboljšaj Vadbeni dojo, da odkleneš sabotere: za nekaj sekund onesposobijo obrambo. Najprej onesposobi, nato udari, in bojevnike ovij v dim tam, kjer je ogenj najhujši. Pobiraj, izboljšuj, napadaj in se pridruži zavezništvu.

codex.rulesButton.text: Kako se svet odziva na vpade

codex.rivalsRule.en: Computer rival clans read your last {n} raids: about {pct} of their outposts are tempered against the warriors you used most.
codex.rivalsRule.text: Klani računalniških tekmecev berejo tvoje zadnje vpade (število: {n}): približno {pct} njihovih postojank je kaljenih proti bojevnikom, ki jih uporabljaš največ.

codex.exhaustionRule.en: For {hours} hours after each raid your village loses, the next raider can take only {pct} as much (two losses multiply).
codex.exhaustionRule.text: Po vsakem vpadu, ki ga tvoja vas izgubi, lahko naslednji napadalec {hours} h odnese le {pct} običajne količine (dva poraza se pomnožita).

codex.temperRule.en: From Clan Keep {level}, defenses can be tempered: Reach shoots farther but softer, Blast hits groups but fires slower, Watch strengthens air defense and traps. Each rival clan leans one way:
codex.temperRule.text: Od ravni {level} Klanske trdnjave lahko obrambne stavbe kališ: Doseg strelja dlje, a šibkeje, Eksplozija zadene skupine, a strelja počasneje, Straža okrepi protizračno obrambo in pasti. Vsak klan tekmecev se nagiba v eno smer:

builders.crewNote.en: The garrison crew builds defenses, traps and support counters without taking a Village Artisan.
builders.crewNote.text: Ekipa garnizije gradi obrambne stavbe, pasti in podporne stavbe, ne da bi zasedla vaškega mojstra.

squad.armed.en: Tap a glowing ring: the rest of your warriors go in through it.
squad.armed.text: Tapni žareči krog: preostali bojevniki gredo noter skozenj.

store.withdrawalStipend.en: Delivery starts at once: the first payment can be claimed now and one more each day; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
store.withdrawalStipend.text: Dobava se začne takoj: prvo plačilo lahko prevzameš zdaj in nato po eno vsak dan; z nakupom se strinjaš, da izgubiš pravico do odstopa, kot to za digitalne vsebine dovoljuje zakon.

store.error.cancelled.text: Nakup je preklican. Nič ni bilo zaračunano.

store.error.unavailable.en: Purchases are not available right now. Try again later.
store.error.unavailable.text: Nakupi trenutno niso na voljo. Poskusi pozneje.

store.error.failed.en: The purchase did not go through. If you were charged, it is delivered as soon as the store confirms it.
store.error.failed.text: Nakup ni uspel. Če je bil znesek zaračunan, bo dobava izvedena, takoj ko trgovina to potrdi.

raid.rejected.defender_protected.text: Ta vas je že imela ščit.

raid.rejected.no_warriors.en: No warriors fought, so it counts as practice.
raid.rejected.no_warriors.text: Noben bojevnik se ni boril, zato šteje kot vaja.

temper.intro.en: Shape every {building} at once. Reach shoots farther but hits softer and goes for back-line warriors first; Blast hits groups but fires slower; Watch makes the Sky Bow Tower, the Bitter Smoke Brazier and traps stronger. Raiders see the shape when they scout.
temper.intro.text: Hkrati oblikuj vse stavbe vrste {building}. Doseg strelja dlje, a šibkeje, in najprej meri na bojevnike v zadnji vrsti; Eksplozija zadene skupine, a strelja počasneje; Straža okrepi Stolp nebesnega loka, Žarovnik grenkega dima in pasti. Napadalci obliko vidijo, ko izvidujejo.

temper.locked.text: Kaljenje se odpre pri Klanski trdnjavi {level}.

temper.done.en: Tempered: every {building} has its new shape.
temper.done.text: Kaljeno: vse stavbe vrste {building} imajo novo obliko.

temper.watchSupport.en: Watch also weakens the raiders' healing, revives, toughness and shield cover across the whole base.
temper.watchSupport.text: Straža po vsej bazi oslabi tudi napadalčevo zdravljenje, oživljanje, žilavost in zaščito s ščiti.

stake.help.en: Declare a result before you attack: reach it and carry more loot home, miss it and carry none.
stake.help.text: Pred napadom napovej izid: če ga dosežeš, odneseš domov več plena, če ne, ne odneseš ničesar.

carry.preview.text: Ta vojska bi odnesla {pct} plena. Odredi z več vlogami odnesejo več.

news.offline.en: Messages from the game's operators arrive when you play online.
news.offline.text: Sporočila upravljavcev igre prispejo, ko igraš na spletu.

account.signOutDevice.note.en: Finished playing on this phone or browser? Sign it out. Your online account stays for your other devices and linked sign-ins.
account.signOutDevice.note.text: Ne igraš več na tem telefonu ali v tem brskalniku? Odjavi ga. Tvoj spletni račun ostane za druge naprave in povezane prijave.

account.signOutDevice.body.en: Online play turns off here and this device forgets its key to your online account. The village on this device stays. To play the account here again, sign in with a linked Apple, Google or Game Center account.
account.signOutDevice.body.text: Spletna igra se tukaj izklopi in ta naprava pozabi ključ do tvojega spletnega računa. Vas v tej napravi ostane. Če želiš račun tukaj znova igrati, se prijavi s povezanim računom Apple, Google ali Game Center.

account.signOutDevice.done.en: This device is signed out. Online play is off here.
account.signOutDevice.done.text: Ta naprava je odjavljena. Spletna igra je tukaj izklopljena.

account.signOutDevice.lastKey.en: Not signed out: this device holds the only key to your online account. Link Apple, Google or Game Center first, or delete the account instead.
account.signOutDevice.lastKey.text: Ni odjavljeno: ta naprava hrani edini ključ do tvojega spletnega računa. Najprej poveži Apple, Google ali Game Center ali pa račun izbriši.

news.reason.resources.en: There were not enough resources in your village on the server.
news.reason.resources.text: V tvoji vasi na strežniku ni bilo dovolj virov.

news.reason.builder.text: Noben vaški mojster ni bil prost.

news.reason.maxLevel.en: It was already at its highest level.
news.reason.maxLevel.text: Najvišja raven je bila že dosežena.

news.reason.gone.en: It was no longer in your village.
news.reason.gone.text: Tega ni bilo več v tvoji vasi.

news.reason.busy.en: It was already being worked on.

news.reason.limit.en: The limit for it was already reached.

news.reason.army.text: Tvoja dvorišča odredov so bila polna.

news.reason.changed.en: Your village had already changed, for example on another device.
news.reason.changed.text: Tvoja vas se je že spremenila, na primer v drugi napravi.

refusal.storageFullRefund.en: Storage is too full: cancelling now would lose {lost} of the {refund} you would get back. Make room first.
refusal.storageFullRefund.text: Skladišče je prepolno: če zdaj prekličeš, izgubiš {lost} od vračila {refund}. Najprej naredi prostor.

league.boardOnline.en: The leaderboards are part of online play.

sheet.raidRule.en: Raiders can take {pct} of what your storages hold, never more than {cap} of each resource while your Keep is level {level}, and {collectors} of what your collectors have not collected yet.
sheet.raidRule.text: Napadalci lahko odnesejo {pct} tega, kar hranijo tvoja skladišča, nikoli več kot {cap} posameznega vira, dokler je tvoja trdnjava na ravni {level}, in {collectors} tega, česar tvoji zbiralniki še niso pobrali.

sheet.collectorPause.en: It produces nothing while it upgrades ({time}). What it holds now stays and can still be collected.
sheet.collectorPause.text: Med izboljšavo ({time}) ne proizvaja ničesar. Kar zdaj hrani, ostane in se še lahko pobere.

unlock.title.en: {n, plural, one {New warrior unlocked!} other {New warriors unlocked!}}
unlock.title.text: {n, plural, one {Odklenjen je nov bojevnik!} two {Odklenjena sta nova bojevnika!} few {Odklenjeni so novi bojevniki!} other {Odklenjeni so novi bojevniki!}}

keep.armyBehind.en: Your warriors' training is more than a Keep behind your village: a higher Keep meets stronger rivals and raiders. Research or train first?
keep.armyBehind.text: Urjenje tvojih bojevnikov za vasjo zaostaja za več kot eno raven trdnjave: z višjo trdnjavo naletiš na močnejše tekmece in napadalce. Najprej raziskave ali urjenje?

scout.lootWontFit.en: Your storage cannot hold all the loot on offer: what does not fit is lost.
scout.lootWontFit.text: Tvoja skladišča ne morejo sprejeti vsega ponujenega plena: kar ne gre vanje, se izgubi.

trials.caughtUp.en: Tiers {from} to {to} are counted as cleared too, each paid once.
trials.caughtUp.text: Kot opravljene štejejo tudi stopnje od {from} do {to}, vsaka se izplača enkrat.

drill.title.text: Dnevna vaja (vadba: nič se ne porabi)

drill.about.en: Daily drill: fight this fortress with a full camp of your own warriors. Nothing is spent, and today's first drill pays a small reward.
drill.about.text: Dnevna vaja: spopadi se s to trdnjavo s polnim taborom lastnih bojevnikov. Nič se ne porabi, prva vaja dneva pa prinese majhno nagrado.

drill.paid.en: Drill done: today's reward is paid. Nothing was spent.
drill.paid.text: Vaja opravljena: današnja nagrada je izplačana. Nič se ni porabilo.

drill.doneToday.en: Today's drill reward is already paid. You can still drill for practice; the next reward comes tomorrow.
drill.doneToday.text: Današnja nagrada za vajo je že izplačana. Še vedno lahko vadiš; naslednja nagrada bo jutri.

scout.shieldEnds.en: Your shield has {time} left: attacking ends it.
scout.shieldEnds.text: Tvoj ščit traja še {time}: napad ga prekine.

tutorial.end.daily.en: Your first daily chest is ready: Finish opens it.
tutorial.end.daily.text: Tvoja prva dnevna skrinja je nared: odpre jo »Končaj«.

panel.loadFailed.en: This could not open. Check your connection and try again.
panel.loadFailed.text: Tega ni bilo mogoče odpreti. Preveri povezavo in poskusi znova.

panel.staleChunk.en: A newer version of Kagemura is out. Reload to open this.
panel.staleChunk.text: Na voljo je novejša različica Kagemure. Znova naloži, da to odpreš.

quality.slowBattles.en: This phone drew battles slowly, so Kagemura will use lighter graphics from the next start. You can change it in Settings → Graphics.
quality.slowBattles.text: Ta telefon je bitke izrisoval počasi, zato bo Kagemura od naslednjega zagona uporabljala lažjo grafiko. To lahko spremeniš v Nastavitve → Grafika.

events.calendar.server.en: Schedule sent by the game's server. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.server.text: Razpored, ki ga je poslal strežnik igre. Vsako odštevanje je resnično.

events.calendar.builtIn.en: Built-in schedule. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.builtIn.text: Vgrajeni razpored. Vsako odštevanje je resnično.

events.fixed.en: Events follow a fixed calendar: a four-week cycle plus five festivals on fixed dates each year. Their times never move or get extended, so the countdown is always the real one.
events.fixed.text: Dogodki sledijo stalnemu koledarju: štiritedenskemu ciklu in petim praznikom na iste datume vsako leto. Njihovi časi se nikoli ne premaknejo ali podaljšajo, zato je odštevanje vedno resnično.

contract.about.en: The same for everyone today; a new one in {time}. It changes only what a won raid carries home.
contract.about.text: Danes enaka za vse; nova čez {time}. Spremeni le, koliko zmagan vpad prinese domov.

events.gauntlet.about.en: A computer-made fortress, the same base for everyone at your Keep this week. No loot inside; each star mark on the ladder pays once.
events.gauntlet.about.text: Računalniško ustvarjena trdnjava, ta teden ista baza za vse pri tvoji ravni trdnjave. V njej ni plena; vsaka oznaka zvezdic na lestvici se izplača enkrat.

events.festival.about.en: A computer-made fortress at your Keep, the same for every attempt. No loot inside; each mark on the ladder pays once, and three stars give the festival's look.
events.festival.about.text: Računalniško ustvarjena trdnjava za tvojo raven trdnjave, enaka pri vsakem poskusu. V njej ni plena; vsaka oznaka na lestvici se izplača enkrat, tri zvezdice pa prinesejo praznični videz.

growth.invite.rule.en: When a friend who started with your friend code reaches Keep {keep} with their village on the server, you each get a fixed reward. Nothing random and nothing to buy.
growth.invite.rule.text: Ko oseba, ki je začela igrati s tvojo kodo za prijatelje, s svojo vasjo na strežniku doseže trdnjavo {keep}, vsak od vaju dobi stalno nagrado. Nič naključnega in nič za kupiti.

growth.invite.reward.en: Reward for each of you: {jade} Jade
growth.invite.reward.text: Nagrada za vsakega od vaju: {jade} žada

growth.invite.cap.en: {cap, plural, one {Rewards for up to # friend a month.} other {Rewards for up to # friends a month.}}
growth.invite.cap.text: {cap, plural, one {Nagrade za največ # prijatelja na mesec.} two {Nagrade za največ # prijatelja na mesec.} few {Nagrade za največ # prijatelje na mesec.} other {Nagrade za največ # prijateljev na mesec.}}

growth.invite.counts.en: Friends who joined with your code: waiting {waiting}, ready {ready}, rewarded {rewarded}
growth.invite.counts.text: Pristopi s tvojo kodo: čaka {waiting}, pripravljeno {ready}, nagrajeno {rewarded}

growth.invite.mine.waiting.en: You joined with a friend's code. Reach Keep {keep} with your village on the server and you both get the reward.
growth.invite.mine.waiting.text: Tvoj pristop je bil s kodo prijatelja. S svojo vasjo na strežniku doseži trdnjavo {keep} in nagrado dobi vsak od vaju.

growth.invite.mine.ready.en: You joined with a friend's code and reached Keep {keep}: your reward is ready.
growth.invite.mine.ready.text: Tvoj pristop je bil s kodo prijatelja in trdnjava {keep} je dosežena: tvoja nagrada je pripravljena.

growth.invite.mine.rewarded.en: You joined with a friend's code and collected your reward.
growth.invite.mine.rewarded.text: Tvoj pristop je bil s kodo prijatelja in tvoja nagrada je pobrana.

growth.invite.needsServer.en: Rewards go to a village on the server. Move your village there in Settings → Online play.
growth.invite.needsServer.text: Nagrade gredo vasi na strežniku. Preseli svojo vas tja v Nastavitve → Spletna igra.

growth.invite.adultsOnly.en: Friend invite rewards are for adults only. You can still add friends and play together.
growth.invite.adultsOnly.text: Nagrade za povabila prijateljev so samo za odrasle. Še vedno lahko dodajaš prijatelje in igrate skupaj.

growth.invite.enterHint.en: {days, plural, one {Enter their friend code within # day of starting online play.} other {Enter their friend code within # days of starting online play.}}
growth.invite.enterHint.text: {days, plural, one {Vnesi kodo prijatelja v # dnevu od začetka spletne igre.} two {Vnesi kodo prijatelja v # dneh od začetka spletne igre.} few {Vnesi kodo prijatelja v # dneh od začetka spletne igre.} other {Vnesi kodo prijatelja v # dneh od začetka spletne igre.}}

growth.share.explain.en: {days, plural, one {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # day under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.} other {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # days under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.}}
growth.share.explain.text: {days, plural, one {Strežnik preveri ta posnetek in ga # dan hrani pod kodo. Gleda ga lahko vsak, ki ima povezavo. Baza je prikazana brez imena, ime nasprotnika pa ni nikoli navedeno.} two {Strežnik preveri ta posnetek in ga # dni hrani pod kodo. Gleda ga lahko vsak, ki ima povezavo. Baza je prikazana brez imena, ime nasprotnika pa ni nikoli navedeno.} few {Strežnik preveri ta posnetek in ga # dni hrani pod kodo. Gleda ga lahko vsak, ki ima povezavo. Baza je prikazana brez imena, ime nasprotnika pa ni nikoli navedeno.} other {Strežnik preveri ta posnetek in ga # dni hrani pod kodo. Gleda ga lahko vsak, ki ima povezavo. Baza je prikazana brez imena, ime nasprotnika pa ni nikoli navedeno.}}

growth.share.minor.en: Your name is not shown on replays shared by players under 18.
growth.share.minor.text: Na posnetkih, ki jih delijo igralci, mlajši od 18 let, tvoje ime ni prikazano.

growth.viewer.generated.en: Against a generated base (made by the computer).

growth.viewer.failed.en: This shared replay could not be opened.
growth.viewer.failed.text: Tega deljenega posnetka ni bilo mogoče odpreti.

growth.viewer.older.en: This replay was recorded under other battle rules, so this version of the game cannot show it.
growth.viewer.older.text: Ta posnetek je bil posnet po drugih bojnih pravilih, zato ga ta različica igre ne more prikazati.

alliance.banner.note.en: Banners only change how the Alliance looks: no advantage in battle or resources.
alliance.banner.note.text: Praporji spremenijo le videz zavezništva: brez prednosti v bitkah ali virih.

stats.tzNote.en: It also sends your time zone's offset from UTC, so days are counted on your own calendar.
stats.tzNote.text: Pošlje tudi zamik tvojega časovnega pasu od UTC, da se dnevi štejejo po tvojem koledarju.

preview.notLive.en: Preview: this is not in the live game yet.
preview.notLive.text: Predogled: tega v igri še ni.

heroPick.intro.en: Choose the hero who joins your attacks.
heroPick.intro.text: Izberi junaka, ki se pridruži tvojim napadom.

heroPick.none.en: No hero can join yet. Heroes join from higher Keep levels.
heroPick.none.text: Noben junak se še ne more pridružiti. Junaki se pridružijo na višjih ravneh trdnjave.

mastery.none.en: Attack with your warriors to earn mastery.
mastery.none.text: Napadaj s svojimi bojevniki, da pridobiš mojstrstvo.

seal.progress.en: Keep seal: {n} of {total} buildings at this Keep's cap. A full Keep earns its seal.
seal.progress.text: Pečat trdnjave: {n} od {total} stavb na najvišji ravni te trdnjave. Polna trdnjava si prisluži pečat.

terms.body.en: The terms of service for Kagemura came into force on {date}. Please read them and accept them to play online. Your village keeps working on this device either way.
terms.body.text: Pogoji uporabe Kagemure veljajo od {date}. Preberi jih in jih sprejmi, da lahko igraš na spletu. Tvoja vas v tej napravi deluje v vsakem primeru.

consent.apple.label.en: Help Apple decide refund requests (off until you turn it on)
consent.apple.label.text: Pomagaj Applu pri odločanju o zahtevah za vračilo (izklopljeno, dokler ne vklopiš)

consent.apple.detail.en: When you ask Apple for a refund, Apple may ask us about the purchase. With this on, we tell Apple that it was delivered and give ranges for how old your account is and how much you have bought and been refunded. Never your name, village or chat. We never ask Apple to refuse a refund.
consent.apple.detail.text: Ko Apple prosiš za vračilo denarja, nas Apple lahko vpraša o nakupu. Če je to vklopljeno, Applu sporočimo, da je bil nakup dostavljen, in navedemo razpone za starost tvojega računa ter znesek tvojih nakupov in vračil. Nikoli tvojega imena, vasi ali klepeta. Applu nikoli ne predlagamo, naj vračilo zavrne.

replays.allowBase.label.en: Allow my base in other players' shared replays
replays.allowBase.label.text: Dovoli prikaz moje baze v posnetkih, ki jih delijo drugi igralci

replays.allowBase.detail.en: When someone shares a replay of a raid on your village, it shows your base layout (never your name). Turn this off and your base is never shown, and shares already made of it are removed.
replays.allowBase.detail.text: Ko nekdo deli posnetek vpada na tvojo vas, ta prikaže razporeditev tvoje baze (nikoli tvojega imena). Če to izklopiš, tvoja baza ni nikoli prikazana, že ustvarjena deljenja z njo pa se odstranijo.

significantUpdate.description.en: This update changes how Kagemura works. A parent or guardian can review it before it is used.
significantUpdate.description.text: Ta posodobitev spremeni delovanje Kagemure. Starš ali skrbnik jo lahko pregleda, preden se začne uporabljati.

season.recap.en: League at season end: {league}. Raids won: {raids}. Stars: {stars}. Scroll tiers: {tiers}.
season.recap.text: Liga ob koncu sezone: {league}. Zmagani vpadi: {raids}. Zvezdice: {stars}. Stopnice zvitka: {tiers}.

welcome.scrollEnded.en: The Season Scroll ended, and the rewards you had not claimed were added:
welcome.scrollEnded.text: Sezonski zvitek se je končal, neprevzete nagrade pa so bile dodane:

pass.bonus.detail.en: {left, plural, =0 {All {max} bonuses collected this season ({got} of {max})} one {Every task still pays: the next bonus in # point ({got} of {max} this season)} other {Every task still pays: the next bonus in # points ({got} of {max} this season)}}
pass.bonus.detail.text: {left, plural, =0 {Zbrani so vsi bonusi te sezone ({got} od {max})} one {Vsaka naloga še šteje: do naslednjega bonusa še # točka ({got} od {max} v tej sezoni)} two {Vsaka naloga še šteje: do naslednjega bonusa še # točki ({got} od {max} v tej sezoni)} few {Vsaka naloga še šteje: do naslednjega bonusa še # točke ({got} od {max} v tej sezoni)} other {Vsaka naloga še šteje: do naslednjega bonusa še # točk ({got} od {max} v tej sezoni)}}
